title: Hillside tower: walking across heights and storeys
about: Lowland at height 0; a terrace two levels up reached only by a one-level ramp tile at (9, 8); a three-level tower on it (ground, floor 1, roof) joined by two flights of stairs; a summit at height 4 ringed by two-level cliffs; a two-storey house on the lowland. Every route is audited: one tile per step, at most one height level of climb, storeys changing only on stairs.
